messages:
Devon R: Quick follow-up from today’s postmortem — we need to finalize owners for the action items from last night's scheduler regression. Recurring cache-eviction pattern noted. Using this thread to collect owners, Jira links, RACI, and handoff notes.

Ajay P: I can take the root-cause remediation (reconciler backoff + leader-election race). I’ll open a Jira and include perf regression test plans.

Devon R: Perfect — please add acceptance criteria and a smoke test so we can validate in Dedicated.

Ajay P: Will do. Draft ticket: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-3741 (ETA Wed EOD).

Maria G: I’ll own the rollout/runbook work: update the canary playbook, add rollback steps, and doc the manual mitigation. I’ll pair with QA on the smoke tests.

Elaine K: I’ll pick up long-term monitoring & alerts tuning (reduce noisy pagers by >50% for eviction signals). I’ll create INF-3742 and wire it into the alerting board. ETA Mon next week.

SRE Ops: oncall-bot pulled last 3 incidents showing same signature — added timeline to the postmortem doc.

Devon R: RACI suggestion for each ticket: Responsible = owner, Accountable = SRE lead, Consulted = infra eng / QA, Informed = product + support. Example: INF-3741 -> R: Ajay P, A: Devon R, C: Maria G / QE, I: Support.

Ajay P: Agreed. I’ll add RACI block to INF-3741.

Maria G: For the rollout ticket (INF-3743) — R: Maria G, A: ProdEng PM (TBD), C: Ajay P, I: Eng Platform. I’ll attach the canary checklist and smoke test commands.

Devon R: Can someone populate the remediation tracker sheet? Link in postmortem doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/spreadsheets/remediation-tracker. Add ticket, owner, due date, and status.

Elaine K: I added INF-3742 to the tracker with target 2026-03-30 and a note about metric thresholds.

Ajay P: INF-3741 updated with acceptance criteria and perf test commands:
```
k8s-sim --evict-threshold=0.9 --run=1000
# smoke: check kv-cache hit-rate > 95% under load
```

SRE Ops: small ask — when tickets are ready, can we mark a canary window and notify oncall 24h before? Last time the canary overlapped a region maintenance.

Maria G: Yep — I’ll schedule the canary and add a calendar invite to #eng-oncall.

Devon R: One more: recurring incident pattern — we should decide whether to add a rolling audit (quarterly) to avoid regressions. Proposal: 3-month audit owned by SRE Ops.

SRE Ops: happy to own the quarterly audit. Will create a recurring JIRA INF-3800 and add to team cadence.

Ajay P: Quick note on handoff: after fix is merged, I’ll hand the rollout to Maria for canary, and Elaine will confirm metric signals are stable for 48h before we close the ticket.

Maria G: Sounds good. I’ll update the runbook with the handoff checklist: (1) merge + deploy, (2) run smoke, (3) 24h canary, (4) rollback steps.

Devon R: Thanks team. I’ll update the postmortem doc with owners, Jira links, RACI, and due dates. Postmortem doc link: https://docs.redwood.ai/postmortems/2026-03-23-scheduler-regression.

Elaine K: :thumbsup: I’ll follow up if alert thresholds need tweaks during canary.

Ajay P: :eyes: assigning INF-3741 to myself now.

Devon R: Closing loop for this thread — if anything else, add to the remediation tracker and ping me.

oncall-bot: Incident summary added to the postmortem. Notifications sent to @eng-oncall and @product.
